question: Who was the son of Shakuntala in Kalidasa's drama of Abhijnana Shakuntalam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharata** was the son of Shakuntala in Kalidasa's drama **Abhijnana Shakuntalam**.
 
• Kalidasa is one of the greatest Sanskrit poets and dramatists, known for his works that include plays, epic poems, and lyric poetry.
 
• **Abhijnana Shakuntalam** is one of Kalidasa's most famous plays, which tells the story of Shakuntala, her love for King Dushyanta, and their son Bharata.
 
• The play is a classic example of ancient Indian literature and has been translated into many languages around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidasa** lived during the Gupta dynasty, which is often referred to as the Golden Age of India due to its advancements in arts, science, and literature.
 
• His works are known for their rich imagery, emotional depth, and elegant use of the Sanskrit language.
 
• Other notable works by Kalidasa include **Raghuvamsha**, **Kumarasambhava**, and **Meghaduta**.
 
• The story of Shakuntala has been adapted into various forms, including theatre, dance, and film, highlighting its enduring popularity and cultural significance.
